about: Shared app schema v4 evaluator vectors. Invented data. Each vector runs one transaction through rules (enabled, ordered by position then id), its txn_overrides row, its txn_splits rows and the category rows. expected.category is the effective category after a built-in merge; owned is the code used outside the app; allocations are signed cents (inflow positive) per category, in order. A rule with match_json/action_json strings uses them verbatim.
